select * from ( select vfp.finprod_id finprodId, vfp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpt.type_1 assetTypeCode, vfp.issuer issuer, vfp.ccy ccy,
(vfp.issue_amt)/10000 sumprice, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') mdate1, vfp.is_sus susYorN, vfp.CALENDAR_ID tradingtime, vfp.profit_type profitType, ext.IS_COMPOUND_INT compoundint, vfp.bln_area blnArea, vfp.capi_income_feature priproflag, '' raisetype, vfp.finprod_market_id opmarketid, '' isNonstandard, (case when para.INT_ACCRUAL_MODE = '0' then '01' when para.INT_ACCRUAL_MODE = '1' then '02' else null end) transactiontype, '' isExpectedprofit, vccr.basis basic, (vccr.yield)*100 ratestr
from FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join fin_CASH_CALC_RULE vccr on vfp.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id left join fin_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr on vfp.finprod_id = vcpr.finprod_id left join fin_product_type fpt ON vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_add ext on ext.finprod_id = vfp.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION_PARA para on vfp.finprod_id = para.finprod_id where 1 = 1 AND vfp.finprod_type = 'F17' AND vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE LIMIT=1

select * from (select (select a.pay_cycle from fin_CASH_PAY_RULE a left join FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT c on a.finprod_id = c.finprod_id where c.finprod_id =#{finprodId} and b.cash_type_1 = '01' and LIMIT=1) retype, fccr.accr_tday_rule jxyyrzz,
vcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, vcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, (case when fci.cash_type_1 = '02' then vcpr.pay_cycle else '' end) paycycle, vcpr.calc_rule calcrule, (case when vcpr.calc_rule = '03' then DATE_FORMAT(vcpr.first_pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') else '' end) fpayDate from fin_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on vcpr.cash_id =fci.cash_id left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE fccr on vcpr.cash_id = fccr.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on vcpr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} --and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE LIMIT=1
select DATE_FORMAT(fccr.eff_date,'%Y-%m-%d') efdate, (fccr.yield)*100 rate2 from fin_cash_calc_rule fccr left join fin_product fp on fccr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jxdatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jxdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, case when fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT=0 then 0 when fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT=null then 0 else (fcp.int_amt/fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT)*100 end byrate from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '02'

select DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date,'%Y-%m-%d') paydate, '' tqrmon, fcp.prin_amt aqrmon, fcp.is_pay_int israte, fcp.int_amt yjrte from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '01'

select distinct DATE_FORMAT(fcp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') jsdatestr, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') jsdateend, DATE_FORMAT(fcp.pay_date, '%Y-%m-%d') paydate from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
